title: Calm can't be forced, it settles (glitter jar reel, vivid)

captions.instagram:
You can't force yourself calm. 🫙

Telling yourself to calm down is like shaking the jar again.
Put it down. Breathe slowly. Give it a minute.
The glitter settles in its own time. Give yourself the same.

Save this for the next time your mind won't settle.

#calm #mindfulness #breathe #emotionalwellness #soundmind
